questions: Should the distance matrix be computed between each sample and every other sample (full pairwise) or between each sample and the centroids of the clusters?
If computing distances to centroids, how should centroids be defined? Should they be the true centers passed to make_blobs, or the empirical means of the generated clusters?
What should be the shape of the distance array if distances are to centroids? Should it be (n_samples, centers) or (n_samples, n_samples) if pairwise between samples?
Should the plot always use the first two feature dimensions, even if make_blobs is called with n_features > 2?
Is the random_seed parameter used only for make_blobs, or also for any other potential randomness in the function?
If plot_path is provided, should the function still create and close a figure, or should it avoid creating a figure at all to save resources?
Should the function raise an error if centers > n_samples, or let make_blobs handle it?
What color mapping should be used for the labels? Should it be a qualitative colormap like 'tab10' or default matplotlib mapping?
